## Which file do I need?

**📱 On your Samsung phone: `ClassicGalaxySounds-…-Android-root-module.zip`**
This is the one most people need. It's a root module, not a sound pack:
install it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch (*Modules → Install*). Put the
official firmware of the old Galaxy in your **Download** folder first; the
module extracts the sounds from it. Requirements and steps:
[README](https://github.com/Kutjaneiro/classic-galaxy-sounds#readme).

> ⚠️ With temporary root, don't press *Reboot* after installing: no reboot is
> needed, and a full reboot drops root.

**💻 Optional, on a computer: `SoundExtractor-…`**
Only if you'd rather extract the sounds on a computer and copy them to the
phone. Pick the one for your system: Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon or Intel)
or Linux.
